title: Lithomarga
summary: LITHOMAR'GA, LITH'OMARGE, noun [Gr. stone, and Latin marga, marl.] An earth of two species, friable and indurated, more siliceous than aluminous, distinguished by its great fineness and its fusibility

inlines.v: LITHOMAR'GA, LITH'OMARGE, noun [Gr. stone, and Latin marga, marl.] An earth of two species, friable and indurated, more siliceous than aluminous, distinguished by its great fineness and its fusibility into a soft slag.
